CREATE PROC [OM].[SP_SRC_CHECK] @task_name [varchar](30),@process_date [datetime] AS
BEGIN

    DECLARE @FLAG_CNT [NUMERIC](15,0)
	DECLARE @FLAG_DUP_CNT [NUMERIC](15,0)

    SELECT
	@FLAG_CNT=(CASE WHEN COUNT(*) <> SUM(COALESCE((CASE WHEN OS.STATUS = 'SUCCESSFUL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0)) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END)
	FROM 
		[OM].[OM_TASK_DEPENDENCY] OTD
	LEFT JOIN
		[OM].[OM_TASK_RUN] OTR
		ON
		OTD.TASK_NAME =  OTR.TASK_NAME AND
		OTR.PROCESS_DATE = @process_date
	LEFT JOIN   
		[OM].[OM_STATUS] OS
		ON
		OTR.STATUS_ID =  OS.STATUS_ID
	WHERE
		OTD.DEPENDENT_TASK_NAME = UPPER(@task_name)
	GROUP BY
		OTD.DEPENDENT_TASK_NAME
		
		
	SELECT
	@FLAG_DUP_CNT = COUNT(*)
	FROM 
		[OM].[OM_TASK_DEPENDENCY] OTD
	INNER JOIN
		[OM].[OM_TASK_RUN_DUP_COUNT] OTRDC
		ON
		OTD.TASK_NAME =  OTRDC.TASK_NAME AND
		OTRDC.PROCESS_DATE = @process_date
	WHERE
		OTD.DEPENDENT_TASK_NAME = UPPER(@task_name)
	GROUP BY
		OTD.DEPENDENT_TASK_NAME

	IF(@FLAG_CNT<>1)
	   BEGIN
		   RAISERROR('JOB %s SOURCES ARE NOT YET AVAILABLE, PLEASE CHECK OM.OM_TASK_RUN TABLE FOR LIST OF SOURCES THAT ARE NOT YET AVAILABLE', 16,1,@task_name)
	   END
	   


	IF(@FLAG_DUP_CNT>0)
	   BEGIN
		   RAISERROR('DUPLICATE RECORDS FOUND IN SOURCE TABLES, PLEASE CHECK OM.OM_TASK_RUN_DUP_COUNT FOR LIST OF TABLES WITH DUPLICATE RECORDS', 16,1)
	   END



END
GO
